stage_skeptic.desc: Skeptic alone on stage, arms crossed, pointing/challenging (hook)

stage_skeptic2.desc: Skeptic alone on stage, asking the question (hook)

stage_both.desc: Skeptic and Friend on stage, Friend answering ("Fair question")

stage_both2.desc: Skeptic and Friend on stage, Friend answering

outro.desc: Skeptic says hm, then both on stage (ending + follow card)

jesus_crowd.desc: Jesus teaching people in a sunny meadow

jesus_sunset.desc: Jesus with a crowd at sunset, joyful, arms raised

garden_night.desc: Jesus praying alone at night in a garden (Gethsemane)

temple_night.desc: Temple courtyard with lamps, elders and Jesus

temple_day.desc: Jerusalem temple courtyard by day, leaders facing Jesus

manger.desc: Newborn Jesus in a manger with Mary and Joseph, warm light

house_child.desc: Young child Jesus with Mary in a house, visitors bowing

caravan_star.desc: Travellers with a camel crossing a desert at night under a star

town_star.desc: Small town at night with a bright star above a house

tomb_risen.desc: Empty tomb at sunrise, risen Jesus standing outside

meadow.desc: Empty green land with trees at dawn (creation, the world)

angry_crowd.desc: Angry leaders picking up stones in a courtyard

night_room.desc: Disciples in a lamp-lit courtyard at night with Jesus

storm_sea.desc: A ship in a stormy dark sea

tent_stars.desc: Abraham outside his tent at night under a sky full of stars (Abraham, God's promise, patriarchs, nomad life)

well_noon.desc: Jesus talking with a woman at a stone well in Samaria at midday (John 4, Samaritans, living water, outsiders welcomed)

lion_prowl.desc: A lion prowling across red rocks at dusk (1 Peter 5:8 "roaring lion", danger, temptation, Daniel, Samson)

rome_forum.desc: Roman city forum with columns, red banners and officials in togas, golden afternoon (Rome, emperors, Pilate, Roman historians, the year 336)

scribe_room.desc: A writer (Paul or a Gospel writer) writing a scroll by oil-lamp light, shelves of scrolls behind (who wrote the Bible, letters, Gospels, old manuscripts)

galilee_boat.desc: Fishermen in a wooden boat on a calm lake at dawn, hills behind (Sea of Galilee, Peter, disciples, calling, fishing)

sinai_mountain.desc: Moses with his staff before a great mountain wrapped in cloud and light (Sinai, the law, Ten Commandments, Deuteronomy; God shown only as light)

three_crosses.desc: Three empty wooden crosses on a hill outside Jerusalem at sunset (the cross, Jesus died for sins, Good Friday; no people, no violence)

shepherds_night.desc: Shepherds with their sheep in a field at night as an angel appears in bright light (Luke 2, Christmas, the good news, Bethlehem fields)

jerusalem_gate.desc: Jerusalem city wall and gate in the morning with travellers and elders (Jerusalem, Israel's leaders, Acts, arriving in the city)

modern_room.desc: Modern-day room at night: a young man on a sofa scrolling his phone, city lights in the window (today, "you", modern questions, social media)

world_families.desc: People of many nations and skin tones standing together on a hill at sunrise (all nations, "all the families of the earth", everyone, the gospel for the world)

moriah_walk.desc: Abraham and young Isaac walking up a mountain path at dawn, Isaac carrying firewood, a ram caught in a bush nearby (Genesis 22, Moriah, faith tested, "God will provide"; no knife, no violence)

cosmos_space.desc: Deep space: a galaxy, glowing nebula and planets drifting past (creation, "who made God?", the universe had a beginning, Psalm 19 "the heavens declare")

prodigal_return.desc: A father running with open arms to welcome his returning son on a country road at sunset (Luke 15, forgiveness, grace, coming home to God)

noah_ark.desc: Noah's ark resting on calm water after the flood, a rainbow in the sky and a dove flying (Genesis 6-9, the flood, God's promise, judgment and rescue)
